additional_info.subject: RE: ID0388946-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000686] Payment terminal Issue CRM:00643001056
additional_info.body:
Hi Chetouah,
We have analyzed the logs and found that the issue was caused by the contactless payment terminal, based on the following findings:
This error occurs when a contactless transaction is rejected, and a PIN entry or card insertion is required—actions that are not supported by the current CCV terminals. The root cause may be one of the following:
Contactless transaction not possible
PIN data required
Additional customer authentication required
Exceeds withdrawal count limit
Unfortunately, there is no solution to this problem other than trying another card or using Apple Pay/Google Pay. Ultimately, the current CCV terminal, which lacks the ability to insert the card and/or input the PIN, will continue to reject contactless payments.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0388946-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000686] Payment terminal Issue CRM:00643001056
additional_info.body:
Hi Chetouah,
Thank you for reaching out.
In response to your query, I would like to clarify that there are no specific issues with our payment terminal. The payment terminal has been implemented in our chargers for the past year, and we have not encountered any problems with its functionality across different regions where it has been used. Additionally, we have not experienced any compatibility issues with MasterCard.
It seems that the issue may be related to the specific MasterCard being used. I would recommend trying with a different MasterCard. Please refer to the information I shared in my previous email for further details.
Please let us know if you have any further queries to discuss, if not we shall proceed with closing this ticket.
Thank you.
With best regards,
